name: note2web
description: Publish Apple Notes to Zenn, Hugo, Jekyll, Qiita, dev.to, note.com, and Hatena Blog via a cron/launchd-driven CLI

scripts.test:ruby: node -e "const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const {readdirSync}=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const dir='ruby/test';const files=readdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}).filter((f)=>f.endsWith('_test.rb')).map((f)=>path.join(dir,f)).sort();if(files.length===0){console.error('no ruby test files found under ruby/test/');process.exit(1);}for(const f of files){console.log('# '+f);execFileSync('ruby',['-Iruby/lib',f],{stdio:'inherit'});}"
scripts.verify:pack: node -e "const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const out=execFileSync('npm',['pack','--dry-run','--json'],{encoding:'utf8'});const files=JSON.parse(out)[0].files.map((f)=>f.path);const required=['ruby/note2web_export.rb','ruby/lib/note2web_export_core.rb','NOTICE'];const missing=required.filter((p)=>!files.includes(p));const testFiles=files.filter((p)=>p.startsWith('ruby/test/'));let ok=true;if(missing.length>0){console.error('npm pack is missing required file(s): '+missing.join(', '));ok=false;}if(testFiles.length>0){console.error('npm pack unexpectedly includes ruby/test/ file(s): '+testFiles.join(', '));ok=false;}if(!ok){process.exit(1);}console.log('verify:pack OK: '+files.length+' files packed; required files present; ruby/test/ excluded');"
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
